[EN] Your presence is requested at the Legion of Arms hall in Velika.

Please report to Hamile at your earliest convenience."I'm on my way."
[ES] Se requiere tu presencia en el salón de la Legion of Arms en Velika.

Por favor, preséntate ante Hamile lo antes posible."I'm on my way."

[EN] Thank you for responding to my request, .

I hope you've been doing well. "Well enough. Why did you summon me?"
[ES] Gracias por responder a mi solicitud, .

Espero que te hayas estado portando bien. "Well enough. Why did you summon me?"

[EN] I've heard good things about you...that you are learning your archery skills quite quickly.

So I thought it might interest you to know that I have developed a new archery technique."A new technique?"
[ES] He escuchado buenas cosas sobre ti... que estás aprendiendo tus habilidades de arquería bastante rápido.

Así que pensé que te interesaría saber que he desarrollado una nueva técnica de arquería."A new technique?"

[EN] It will be a new skill for you to learn.

It's something I've been working on for quite a while, actually. I thought that, as such an eager archer, you would want to learn it as soon as possible."Okay, I'm definitely interested."
[ES] Será una nueva habilidad para que aprendas.

En realidad, es algo en lo que he estado trabajando durante bastante tiempo. Pensé que, como arquero tan entusiasta, querrías aprenderla lo antes posible."Okay, I'm definitely interested."

[EN] It will take some effort. I need to be clear about that.

Six steps in total, but the rewards are well worth.

Still want to try?"Yes. Count me in."
[ES] Tomará algo de esfuerzo. Necesito dejar eso en claro.

Seis pasos en total, pero las recompensas valen mucho la pena.

¿Aún quieres intentarlo?"Yes. Count me in."

[EN] The first two steps are fairly simple.

Just clear two dungeons suitable for your level. You can also just clear the same dungeon twice."Okay, that's easy enough."
[ES] Los primeros dos pasos son bastante simples.

Simplemente supera dos calabozos adecuados para tu nivel. También puedes superar el mismo calabozo dos veces."Okay, that's easy enough."

[EN] It might sound easy, but don't let your confidence get the better of you. Dungeons are dangerous...particularly if you go alone."I understand. I'll be back soon."
[ES] Puede sonar fácil, pero no dejes que tu confianza te traicione. Los calabozos son peligrosos... en particular si vas solo."I understand. I'll be back soon."

[EN] Well done, . You still have a long way to go, though.

It will take you some time, but when you're ready for the next step in your training, I'll fill you in on the details, and the rewards.

Take some time to decide if you're truly ready."Okay. Thank you."
[ES] Bien hecho, . Sin embargo, aún te queda un largo camino por recorrer.

Te tomará algún tiempo, pero cuando estés listo para el siguiente paso en tu entrenamiento, te daré los detalles y las recompensas.

Tómate un tiempo para decidir si realmente estás listo."Okay. Thank you."
